name: KD28 SDP SRAM storage and models
connection: External read-only checkout supplied by KD28_ROOT; no adjacent-directory default or copied source

functional_contract.clocks: Write and read ports bound to the same UPLI clock
functional_contract.read_latency: Registered Q after read-request edge, captured by controller at next edge
functional_contract.read_write_same_address: Excluded by FIFO ownership/address proof, not relying on unspecified collision data
functional_contract.logical_depth: 1..65535 in new controller, non-power-of-two allowed; physical map is at least depth2

reset_adaptation: Do not use kd28_sync_fifo's asynchronous-reset controller; custom synchronous controller clears ownership/pending/cache. SRAM contents and map bank-read state are not reset; old data cannot become valid.

warning_waiver.reason: One observed file intentionally defines all fixed SRAM cell modules; no global -Wno-fatal or authored RTL waiver

authorization.local_use: Explicit user authorization to use existing project FIFO/SRAM models
authorization.source_license: Source repository license policy lists candidate licenses; no blanket redistribution grant inferred. Synthetic Liberty files have Apache-2.0 generated-view headers; this does not relicense all RTL.
authorization.redistribution_status: Not asserted; external files remain outside candidates
